Alexandra House is 4 storey strata development located across the street from the expansive greenery of Quilchena Park on tree-line Valley Drive .  A quality build by Polygon featuring Shaughnessy-style architecture, nine-foot ceilings, outdoor swimming pool, stainless steel kitchen appliances, and fitness and social centres, surrounding a tranquille garden courtyard at the centre of the complex. Other Notable Features:Two Secure Underground Parking Stalls Included, Visitor Parking, In Suite 8 ft X 5.5 ft in-suite flex/storage room,Parkade storage locker,Enclosed solarium, Gym Open from 6 AM to 11 PM, andEnterphone Building Entry System.   Available now. Credit Checks and Tenant Insurance Required.  Move-In Fee per Strata Bylaws and requirements.  Professionally managed by Macdonald Commercial RES Ltd.  Contact Licensed Agent Mario Tancredi for viewing.
